title: Basic Word Order and Negation
subtitle: SVO default. Non before the verb. Subject pronouns optional.
objectives: Understand basic word order and negation.
Apply basic word order and negation in reading and composition.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: This lesson covers basic word order and negation. Italian grammar builds on patterns you have already learned. Focus on recognizing forms in context before producing them.

sections.heading: From Italian literature
sections.body: Real examples from Dante, Petrarch, Boccaccio, Machiavelli, Leopardi, or Manzoni illustrate this grammatical point in living use.

items.prompt: What is the main function of basic word order and negation?

sections.heading: Up next
sections.body: The next lesson continues building your command of Italian grammar and vocabulary.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you have mastered basic word order and negation.
